name: kingdom-factor
description: Kingdom Factor internal skill suite. Includes kf-prospecting (operator console for the n8n prospect pipeline: what is stuck and why, fix a row, start a re-run), kf-n8n-ops (maintaining the pipeline workflow and push tools), and kf-marketing-manager (plain-English coach marketing reports via the kingdom-factor app's hosted, OAuth-protected, role-scoped remote MCP connector).
